# AIAPPSY

> Frontier AI Application Studio & Bespoke Action Agent Engineering Consultancy.

AIAPPSY conceives, builds, and deploys high-utility proprietary SaaS applications, engineers bespoke autonomous AI action agents for enterprise workflows, and licenses turnkey white-label software solutions. Headquartered with native Norwegian business ecosystem integrations (Fiken, Tripletex, Vipps, BankID) and global Google Cloud Run infrastructure.

## Core Software Platforms

- [Hubzoo](https://aiappsy.com/apps/hubzoo.html): Autonomous sales assistant and CRM for SMBs, contractors, and field consultants. Generates professional quotes in 60 seconds on mobile while on site, with automated multi-channel follow-up across WhatsApp, SMS, and Email. Native 2-way sync to Fiken and Tripletex accounting software.
- [Upworkz](https://aiappsy.com/apps/upworkz.html): Proposal hook optimizer and job scoring engine using the 220-character rule to bypass mobile inbox truncation and win high-budget freelance and consulting contracts.
- [SubSentry](https://aiappsy.com/apps/subsentry.html): Corporate SaaS waste audit, shadow IT detector, and duplicate billing watchdog. Audits bank feeds and SaaS invoices to uncover hidden price hikes and phantom seats, saving companies 15% to 35% on software bloat.
- [MaxMotion AI](https://aiappsy.com/apps/maxmotion.html): Unified multi-model generative AI video canvas combining Wan 2.1, Kling 1.5, and MiniMax Hailuo with persistent Google Cloud Storage.
- [AppSave](https://aiappsy.com/apps/appsave.html): Manifest V3 browser extension auto-testing verified promo codes on checkout pages to save teams 15% to 40% on recurring software and cloud hosting.
- [MediaBunny](https://aiappsy.com/apps/mediabunny.html): On-device WebAssembly media converter, broadcast-standard EBU R128 audio normalizer, and 75% video compressor with zero server data upload.
- [Manus AI Studio](https://aiappsy.com/apps/manus.html): Autonomous action agent equipped with headless browser navigation and self-healing task loops to complete end-to-end knowledge and scraping work unattended.

## Custom Engineering Services

- [Custom AI Development](https://aiappsy.com/custom-development.html): Bespoke software engineering taking companies from concept to production software in 7 to 14 days. 100% intellectual property and source code ownership transfer. Specializing in autonomous action agents, generative media pipelines, Next.js 15 apps, and ERP bridges (Fiken, Tripletex, Vipps, Salesforce, HubSpot).

## Turnkey Whitelabel Marketplace

- [Whitelabel Catalog](https://aiappsy.com/portfolio.html): Turnkey white-label SaaS licensing. Launch any of our 7 platforms or 50+ templates under your company domain and brand with 100% managed cloud infrastructure and zero code maintenance.

## Detailed System Capabilities

### 1. Autonomous Action Agents
AIAPPSY action agents differ from traditional conversational LLMs by executing state-machine workflows:
- Visual DOM element grounding via multimodal perception.
- Resilient self-healing retry strategies upon page mutation.
- Sandboxed bash/python execution for dynamic computation.
- Human-in-the-Loop approval checkpoints for sensitive financial or contract triggers.

### 2. Norwegian Business Integrations
- Fiken API: Two-way webhook sync for sales leads, auto-creating customers and drafts.
- Tripletex API: Automated orderline insertion and project registration.
- Vipps & BankID: Seamless consumer and enterprise identity and payment checkout flows.
- GDPR Compliance: Tenant-isolated databases with zero persistent storage of confidential customer data.

### 3. Commercial Licensing Terms
- Turnkey Whitelabel: Custom domain, SSL, automated hosting, ongoing model upgrades, 95%+ gross margins.
- Rent-to-Own: 70% of monthly license fees credited toward full source code purchase.
- Full IP Buyout: Complete GitHub repository transfer, documentation handover, and unconditional commercial rights.
